snippet.title: N PLUS INFINITY TIMES TWO Announce trailer
snippet.description:
N PLUS INFINITY TIMES TWO: 5 fresh flavors of world-class online mayhem from Metanet Software, from Friendship-Testing™ Co-op to Friendship-Ending™ Competitive, plus classic singleplayer. Run around with friends, lure enemies into opponents, make the ultimate sacrifice for teammates, and hunt each other with rockets. Couch-ready, Tournament-worthy.

Wishlist on Steam now! https://store.steampowered.com/app/3040020/N_PLUS_INFINITY_TIMES_TWO/

Join the discord to help us beta test: https://discord.com/invite/nplusplus

Video by Richard E Flanagan: https://www.richardeflanagan.com/
Music by Zorza: https://saikelabel.bandcamp.com/track/swan-king
